title: quiz block props
description: A single- or multiple-choice question with elaborated feedback. Either reuse a validated plan question (questionRef) or write the question inline (stem, mode, options) for non-locked practice. presentation text lists the options; images shows them as picture cards (each option's image and alt); image places them as numbered zones on one picture (image, alt; each option's x and y), named « Zone 1 »… for screen readers until the answer is final.
x-ai-instructions: Prefer questionRef when the plan has the question. Inline items: 3 plausible options (C1), no 'all/none of the above', no unflagged negation, homogeneous option length, elaborated feedback for every option explaining why (D1), contextualised at the objective's Bloom level (C2). presentation images when the options are things to recognise by sight (a part, a sign, a screen), each picture with an alt that describes it without giving the answer away; image to find something on one picture (a component on a board, a field on a form): place each option's x and y (0 to 1 from the top left) on the thing, three to six zones, the stem saying what to find.

presentation.description: text: the options as a list. images: a grid of picture cards, each option with its image and alt. image: one picture (image, alt) with the options as zones placed at their x and y.

image.description: image: the picture the zones are placed on.

alt.description: image: what the picture shows, without naming the zones' answers.

questionRef.description: Id of a plan question. When set, do not set stem, mode or options.

alt.description: images: what the option's picture shows.

x.description: image: where the zone is across the picture, 0 (left edge) to 1 (right edge).

y.description: image: where the zone is down the picture, 0 (top) to 1 (bottom).

objective.description: Plan objective measured. Taken from the plan question when questionRef is used.

attempts.description: Tries before the answer is final.

showCorrectAnswer.description: After the last try, highlight the correct options.

feedbackStyle.description: How the feedback of the options chosen is shown under the question. full: each option's text in bold, then its feedback. compact: its feedback only, the option being marked where it is (screen readers still hear its text first): about half the room an answered question reserves on a slide, so that two questions fit side by side. With several options' feedback at once (multiple choice), each keeps its text.
